description: The office HIL batch mission (scripts/sim/office_batch): drive straight 5 m, then drive into the door on the LEFT and stop in it, facing the way through. The start poses (docs/analysis/simulation/2026-11-13_office-feasible-tests, find_door_runup.py --run 5 --side left) put a doorway exactly 2 m to the car's left at the end of the 5 m. Same second move as src/f1tenth_behavior/missions/straight_2m_then_left_door.json (door picked once when the move starts: the nearest STRONG confirmed door on the left; default pre-point on the door axis). Written by hand, not by the LLM: the llm package of this line has no enter_door intent, and a fixed mission makes the three planner modes run exactly the same moves.
